title: Intrinsic complete-object property using the canonical complex representative
statement: Let $d$ be an adic coefficient datum over a commutative ring $A$ in universe $t+1$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], let $T$ be a scheme in universe $t$, and let $a:\mathrm{Fin}(r)\to A$ be a finite tuple with $\operatorname{span}(\operatorname{range}(a))=d.I$. In the derived category of modules over the actual completed coefficient sheaf on the small pro-etale site of $T$ (the module category $\mathrm{pbcModules}(T,\mathrm{pbcAdicCompletion}(T,d))$ of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]), define the object property $\mathrm{cbcCompleteProperty}(d,T,r,a)$ by evaluating intrinsic derived completeness [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion] on the specified preimage complex of the localization functor $Q$, $Q.\mathrm{objPreimage}(K)$ and specified isomorphism $Q.\mathrm{objObjPreimageIso}(K):Q(Q.\mathrm{objPreimage}(K))\simeq K$. Thus the property of $K$ is invertibility of the intrinsic completion unit transported by this specified realization isomorphism. The predicate retains the tuple and its ideal-generation equality, including $r=0$ when the empty tuple generates the ideal; it adds no boundedness or constructibility condition.
